items.html: The explanation of the matter is that these two Names, Metzpatz and Metzpatz, which are in the two corners, from there ZON suckle — the sun and the moon — and they are equal in one equality in the two corners of the head, and both of them are Names of Metzpatz, and they are not one YHVH and the other Elohim, for that is the aspect of the great light and the small light. But the root of ZON, being here in these two corners — for here is their root, from the Hesed and Gevura of the brain of Arich Anpin — they are equal, the great lights, and both of them are of the aspect of the Names that are Metzpatz and Metzpatz, and there is no difference between them, except that this one is on the right and this one is on the left, as is known, for the Nukva is on the left. Also, below there is another reason.
